seo.home.title: ITZA: See Earth Through Time
seo.home.description: ITZA reads your field's history from NASA satellite data, replays every real past season on candidate crop rotations, and shows which rotation would have held up best and why.
seo.demo.title: Guided demo
seo.demo.description: A short guided tour of ITZA on real fields in Algeria and Colorado: past seasons from NASA satellites, the best crop rotation, and how it holds up in 2050.
seo.field.title: Your field
seo.field.description: Pick or draw your field on the map. ITZA gathers its weather, vegetation, soil and terrain from NASA satellite data.
seo.twin.title: 3D view of your field
seo.twin.description: Your field in 3D: real terrain, slope and how green it was through past seasons, from NASA satellite data.
seo.history.title: Past seasons
seo.history.description: Every past season on your field, read from NASA satellites: when crops grew, fallow years and how green each season was.
seo.climate.title: Your field's climate
seo.climate.description: The climate of your field season by season: rain, heat, frost and dry spells from NASA data.
seo.inputs.title: Your farm
seo.inputs.description: Tell ITZA your current rotation, soil and priorities so the comparison fits your farm.
seo.compare.title: Compare crop rotations
seo.compare.description: See which crop rotation would have held up best over your field's real past seasons, and why.
seo.builder.title: Build a rotation
seo.builder.description: Build your own crop rotation and see how it would have done on your field's real past seasons.
seo.future.title: Your field in 2050
seo.future.description: Your real past seasons replayed in the warmer climate expected around 2050: which crop rotation still holds up.
seo.arena.title: Decide
seo.arena.description: Compare ITZA's rotation rules, a machine-learning model and what satellites actually saw on your field.
seo.validation.title: How accurate is ITZA?
seo.validation.description: ITZA's field history checked against independent ground truth: USDA crop maps, rain gauges and evapotranspiration.
seo.ask.title: Ask ITZA
seo.ask.description: Ask questions about your field and your crop rotations in plain words; answers come from ITZA's own data.
seo.sources.title: Data sources
seo.sources.description: Every dataset ITZA uses, from NASA satellites and partners, with its resolution, period and license.
seo.settings.title: Settings
seo.settings.description: ITZA settings: offline use and stored data.
